summary: Spotify Technology S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes standard financial disclosures: revenue of €4,777 million for Q2 2026, operating income of €655 million, and net income of €545 million. No special-situation event (e.g., acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring) is present. The document is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a quarterly earnings release. No corporate action, deal terms, or extraordinary transaction is described, so the appropriate category is 'None'.
